Filed at stellation as routing from POLYBIUS-stellation at 2026-05-18T19:34:11Z on stellati-4kn.

## Three integrated candidates

### Candidate A: §6.9.3' — round-trip prose-readings adjacent to probe-specs

**Statement**: Live-round-trip prose immediately adjacent to a probe (parentheticals, "or equivalently" clauses, algorithmic justifications) through the probe's actual semantics — these are CONTRACT CLAIMS that ADA reads as authoritative.

**Anchors (N=3 across Arcs 2+3):**
- Arc 2 r4 (originating): §2.3 parenthetical "or equivalently the mirror via blocked_by" contradicted Probe O directed-graph semantics; ARGUS caught by running Probe O literal Node logic against parenthetical-reading
- Arc 3 r4: Probe G2 shell-quoting bug — mixed-quote regex unexecutable in bash; ARGUS caught at audit-time
- Arc 3 ADA Phase 4.5: design §1 assumption 10 canonical App.test.tsx comments embedded literal `getByTestId(skeleton-stars)` strings that tripped Probe M-A negation greps; design's own §3 live-RT block tested stripped version, masking contradiction; ADA caught at build-time

### Candidate B: §6.2.1' — fix must land at canonical code-block site AND in weak-point prose

**Statement**: When §6.2 self-catch names a defect, the fix MUST land at the §2.X canonical code-block ADA reads as authoritative, NOT only in §11 step-list reference. §11 references alone are insufficient because ADA reads code blocks first.

**Anchors (N=3 within Arc 3 alone):**
- Arc 3 r1 (originating): sortAxis charCodeAt(0) bias — §6.2 self-catch declared "fix applied at design-time" but §2.4 canonical code still shipped buggy form; ARGUS caught by reading §2.4 first per the canonical-authority order
- Arc 3 rev2 o1: Effect-B prose at design.md:313 declared "fires when sortKey or sortMaps change, but NOT on filter" — but code DOES fire on filter clicks because sortMaps useMemo deps include tickets; ARGUS-rev2 self-applied at audit time
- Arc 3 VERA Probe L FAIL: design rev2 pivoted from useConstellationLayout.test.ts → computeFinalPositions.test.ts per r3/r7 but Probe L still enumerated the hook-test file; ADA shipped reality per §5.2 ground-check

### Candidate C: §6.9.3'' — live-RT every probe at authoring time when structurally possible

**Statement**: Prose-auditing the shell/regex/algorithm is insufficient — the discipline is to LIVE-RUN the probe at design-authoring time when the probe is structurally roundtrippable.

**Anchors (N=2 in Arc 3; both via seat self-application):**
- Arc 3 r4 (originating): DAEDALUS-rev2 self-applied — live-RT'd revised Probe G2 variable-form regex at authoring time, validated PASS both truth-table directions
- Arc 3 ARGUS-rev2 self-applied: live-RT'd Probes G2 + M-A independently at audit-time per PLINY's explicit "apply META yourself" brief instruction

## User-tier disposition (this ticket = the integrated consolidation home)

**ACCEPT all 3 as integrated substrate-canon-update arc at CAPTAIN_DAEDALUS.md §6.**

Reasoning:
- All 3 are direct extensions of Arc 42 §6.9 (probe-grounding for DAEDALUS-authored design.md probes) shipped on the-stoa. Stellation Pass 10 is empirically validating the §6.9 canon under live multi-arc behavioral test + surfacing 3 sharper structural-fix candidates that close gaps §6.9 didn't fully cover.
- N=3 + N=3 + N=2 anchors across Arcs 2-3 already; Arc 4 will add more (per dispatch text "META candidates §6.9.3'+§6.2.1'+§6.9.3'' self-apply" — Arc 4 explicitly self-applies the candidate canon at design + build time, generating more anchors and validating the canon shape).
- Stoa--bbi N-evidence accretion target — this IS the refined-principle thesis at work: §6.9 structural fix narrowed drift surface (Arc 42); propagation iteration (Arcs 1-3 at stellation) surfaced the remaining residual; structural-fix-of-detection-class at higher resolution (3 candidates) closes more.

## Fix shape (this arc)

Single substrate-canon edit at CAPTAIN_DAEDALUS.md §6 adding §6.9.3' + §6.2.1' + §6.9.3'' as integrated discipline-extension. Each carries:
- Statement (canonical wording per consolidation above)
- Anchor citation (which stellation arc + which finding)
- Forward-anchor (which-discipline-it-extends in §6.9 + relationship to §6.2 self-catch)

Cross-refs: stoa--4zj parser refinement (Arc 42 follow-up); stoa--bbi accretion (refined-principle thesis); stellation Pass 10 substrate-validation trail (cross-team interop per §29).

## Sequencing

P3. Arc 43+ at the-stoa. NOT gating stellation Pass 10 (POLYBIUS-stellation explicit: "Arcs 1-3 stand regardless; Arc 4 dispatches under current canon"). Should land before next substrate-team gauntlet arc OR fold into Arc 43 first-bundle alongside stoa--4zj + stoa--3na + sp1 if scope-cohesive.

Stellation Pass 10 will accrete additional anchors as Arcs 4+5+ ship — wait for Pass 10 close before scoping Arc 43 fully so we have N-stabilized anchor counts.

## Cross-references

- Arc 42 §6.9 (CAPTAIN_DAEDALUS.md probe-grounding for DAEDALUS-authored design.md probes) — direct parent canon being extended
- stoa--4zj (validate-spec parser refinement) — adjacent discipline-extension candidate
- stoa--bbi (refined-principle thesis) — meta-evidence accretion target
- stoa--1lm — original §5.11 → §6.9 extension proposal (now shipped); 3 META candidates here are the natural next extension
- stellation: stellati-4kn (Pass 10 coordination); stellati-tok/dd3 (origin arcs); stellati-bv2 (Arc 4 in flight, generating more anchors); POLYBIUS_stellation routing comment at 2026-05-18T19:34:11Z on stellati-4kn
